spec.rawSql:
SELECT
 upper(replaceRegexpAll(a.Node, '-cr6.*$', '')) as Node,
 upper(replaceRegexpAll(a.OutboundSource, '-cr6.*$', '')) as Source,
 upper(replaceRegexpAll(a.OutboundDestination, '-cr6.*$', '')) as Destination,
 b.InboundVolume As InboundVolume,
 a.OutboundVolume AS OutboundVolume,
 a.OutboundVolume + b.InboundVolume AS TotalVolume
FROM
 (
   SELECT
     data_flow.device_id AS Node,
     data_flow.device_id AS OutboundSource,
     remote_if.device_id AS OutboundDestination,
     SUM(data_flow.bit_count) / 8 AS OutboundVolume
   FROM
     data_flow
     INNER JOIN meta_interface AS local_if ON data_flow.out_interface_id = local_if.id
     INNER JOIN meta_interface AS remote_if ON local_if.remote_interface_id = remote_if.id
   WHERE
     $__timeFilter(start_time) AND (src_as_id IN (401015,14031) OR dst_as_id IN (401015,14031))
   GROUP BY
     Node,
     OutboundSource,
     OutboundDestination
 ) AS a INNER JOIN (
   SELECT
     data_flow.device_id AS Node,
     remote_if.device_id AS InboundSource,
     data_flow.device_id AS InboundDestination,
     SUM(data_flow.bit_count) / 8 AS InboundVolume
   FROM
     data_flow
     INNER JOIN meta_interface AS local_if ON data_flow.in_interface_id = local_if.id
     INNER JOIN meta_interface AS remote_if ON local_if.remote_interface_id = remote_if.id
   WHERE
     $__timeFilter(start_time) AND (src_as_id IN (401015,14031) OR dst_as_id IN (401015,14031))
   GROUP BY
     Node,
     InboundSource,
     InboundDestination
 ) AS b
ON
 a.Node = b.Node AND a.OutboundSource = b.InboundDestination AND a.OutboundDestination = b.InboundSource

SELECT
  src_as_id AS as_id,
  meta_as.name AS as_name,
  SUM(bit_count)/8 AS volume
FROM
  data_flow_by_edge_as_5m AS flow
LEFT JOIN meta_as ON meta_as.ref = src_as_ref
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND out_interface_edge = true 
  AND dst_as_id IN (401015,14031)
GROUP BY
  as_id,
  as_name
ORDER BY
  volume DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  dst_as_id AS as_id,
  meta_as.name AS as_name,
  SUM(bit_count)/8 AS volume
FROM
  data_flow_by_edge_as_5m AS flow
LEFT JOIN meta_as ON meta_as.ref = dst_as_ref
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND out_interface_edge = true 
  AND src_as_id IN (401015,14031)
GROUP BY
  as_id,
  as_name
ORDER BY
  volume DESC
LIMIT 50

spec.title: Traffic by Top 50 ASes Receiving from SCinet Over Time

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  concat(dst_as_id, ':', coalesce(meta_as.name, 'Unknowm')) as as_name,
  SUM(bit_count)/8 AS volume
FROM data_flow_by_edge_as_5m AS flow
LEFT JOIN meta_as ON meta_as.ref = dst_as_ref
WHERE src_as_id IN (401015,14031) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND out_interface_edge = true AND dst_as_id IN (
  SELECT dst_as_id FROM data_flow_by_edge_as_5m WHERE src_as_id IN (401015,14031) AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY dst_as_id ORDER BY SUM(bit_count) DESC LIMIT 50
)
GROUP BY time, as_name
ORDER BY time

LEFT JOIN meta_as ON meta_as.ref = src_as_ref
WHERE dst_as_id IN (401015,14031) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND out_interface_edge = true AND src_as_id IN (
  SELECT src_as_id FROM data_flow_by_edge_as_5m WHERE dst_as_id IN (401015,14031) AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY src_as_id ORDER BY SUM(bit_count) DESC LIMIT 50
)
